description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Merge commit of PDP-Connect/data-connect PR #34 ('rebuild rejected terminal commits'), confirmed an ancestor of main as of 2026-08-31 via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`. Discovered stale: pdpp's own committed vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz (see pdpp's vendor/README.md provenance commits d8470bcfd5/ceb6ced321) was packed from this commit, not from the prior 9155e57 pin here — the tarball-digest drift check (job c) failed against 9155e57 and passes against this SHA (verified locally: fresh repack of pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz from this commit is byte-identical to pdpp's committed copy, sha256 39a94ba1...). This repo's own vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz and vendor/pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz were re-packed from this SHA in the same change that moved this pin (see packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/SHA256SUMS). Supersedes the prior 9155e57ae4 pin (PR #30, 2026-08-20). Source of truth for drift jobs (a) collector-definitions snapshot, (b) vendored connector sources, and the 0.0.1 half of (c) tarball digests.

data-connect-1-0-0.note: A SEPARATE, later data-connect SHA used ONLY by the 1.0.0 half of drift job (c) tarball-digests — deliberately NOT the same value as the `data-connect` pin above. pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS (see pdpp's vendor/README.md 'Current 1.0.0 release-boundary pins') records pdpp-collector-runtime-1.0.0.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-1.0.0.tgz packed from this exact commit — data-connect PR #36's reviewer-confirmed head, 'chore: add missing Apache-2.0 SPDX headers to package-artifact scripts' — by applying the two `.releaserc.yaml` prepare-phase mutations (scripts/pin-collector-runtime-protocol-dependency.ts, then `npm version 1.0.0`) documented there. Confirmed an ancestor of data-connect's main as of 2026-08-31 via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, and confirmed a DESCENDANT of the `data-connect` pin above (`git merge-base --is-ancestor 0bc3f8c5b4... 10f25a3cd6...` succeeds) — not a divergent branch. This SHA is NOT used for jobs (a)/(b) or the 0.0.1 tarball repack: verified locally that data-connect's local-collector/collector-runtime/connector-protocol sources changed materially between the two commits (STREAM_EVIDENCE outcomes-partition wire change, capability-array validation, package-artifact receipts), so reusing this SHA for the shared `data-connect` pin would flip jobs (a)/(b) and the 0.0.1 repack from passing to failing — those still compare against data-connectors' and pdpp's committed 0.0.1 artifacts, which were packed from the OLDER `data-connect` pin and have not been repinned to 1.0.0 themselves. Revisit consolidating these two pins into one only once data-connectors' own packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/ moves off 0.0.1.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp PR #238 (`waspflow/vendor-protocol-stream-evidence-0828`) as of 2026-08-31, one commit ahead of the prior 8d42fe86e pin (`chore(vendor): refresh data-connect package artifacts`, no intervening commits). `branch` unchanged: c3e5ae157 is on the same PR-head branch, still open, not yet merged to main. Verified no-op for drift jobs (a)/(b)/(d): packages/reference-contract/src/{common/index.ts,evidence/coherence.ts,evidence/collection-scope.ts} are byte-identical between 8d42fe86e and c3e5ae157 (`git diff` empty for all three), and the commit between them touches only pdpp's own vendor/ and pin-verification scripts, not collector-definitions or connector sources. PR #238 is still open (not yet merged to main), so `branch` deliberately tracks the PR-head branch rather than `main` per this workflow's own coordinated-cutover mechanism (see cross-repo-integrity.yml's read-pins/pin-freshness comments) — main and this branch are expected to disagree on packages/reference-contract and reference-implementation until #238 merges. Revert `branch` to `main` once #238 lands. Supersedes the prior 8d42fe86e pin (2026-08-31, PR #44) and 5eacd82e pin (main as of 2026-08-20).
